name: BillingNow
summary: Invoicing and expense tracking with AI — unlimited invoices, expenses, clients and users on one flat plan, monthly or yearly, made in Geneva.
best_for: freelancers and small teams that want unlimited invoicing, expenses and client management with zero per-user maths: users are unlimited on both plans, so a five-person team pays $2.00 a head
skip_if: you need accountant-grade features, payroll or deep integrations (the incumbents' ecosystems are bigger), or you have an existing client list to bring across: the help centre documents export but no import, so every client has to be retyped
honest_knock: The pricing is refreshing: two plans, same features on both, unlimited users, no per-seat maths. The honest watch-out is the trial length rather than its terms: three days is short for migrating billing into a new tool, and the practical constraint is that there is no import path. The help centre documents CSV and Excel export but no import, so an existing client list has to be retyped, which is more than three days of work for anyone with a real book. It is also a young product from a small Geneva maker, so weigh ecosystem depth and longevity before you move your billing history in.

pricing.entry_price_terms: a month, or $99.90 a year ($8.33/mo), 3-day trial, no card required
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-09 on their own pricing FAQ and refund policy; first verified 2026-08-20) Two plans, both carrying the identical feature list with no limits: $9.99 a month, or $99.90 a year which the page itself works out to $8.33 a month and labels 'Save 17%'. Both include unlimited invoices, expenses, client relations, users, estimates and credit notes, plus payment tracking, tax rates, PDF export and the AI assistant. There are no per-user fees and no feature-gated tier. The trial is 3 days and the page states three separate times that no credit card is required to start it. SOC 2 Type II certified with European-standard compliant invoices.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 2 November 2026 on the free trial: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We created one made-up client and a draft invoice, exported invoices to CSV and downloaded the PDF. Nothing was sent and no payment was connected.
findings: We saw no trial banner or countdown anywhere, although the homepage promises a 3-day free trial; General settings simply showed 'Premium Plan'.
A Dutch organisation in euros came with no tax rates set up. After we added 21% by hand, the draft for EUR 10.00 showed the tax as EUR 2.1.
The invoice CSV is a one-row summary: client, dates, total and balance (written as 12.1 rather than 12.10). It has no line items, description, tax or net amount.
A line-item description accepted a second line, but only the first line was visible in the invoice row.
The Developers page offers API keys 'for the CLI and your integrations' straight away; adding a user asks only for a name and email, with no choice of role.
not_tested: What happens when the 3-day trial ends
Sending an invoice and taking a payment
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
